name: daily_brief_source_control_v3
description: Brief coverage: fixed Seeds graph, bounded output; production cost separately measured.
template:
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX seeds: <https://seeds.local/ontology/>
PREFIX q: <https://scbrown.github.io/quechua/ns#>
PREFIX ical: <http://www.w3.org/2002/12/cal/ical#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?item ?revision WHERE { GRAPH <https://seeds.local/project/aegis> { VALUES ?item { <https://seeds.local/item/aegis-blh.1> } ?item schema:version ?revision . } } LIMIT 2
scope: exact known source item population control
